A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sith Saber''' was part of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[44 ABY]], the Human served in a mission to capture the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]] on the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. During the mission, he and three other [[Sith Saber]]s [[First duel in Kesla Vein|ambushed]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], and former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] [[Kesla Vein]]. During the fight, the Saber was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Ben Skywalker.

==Biography==
[[File:BenSkywalker_Atlas.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ben Skywalker, the Sith Saber's killer]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] after the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. Born on the isolated [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], he was taken and [[Sith training|trained]] by the Lost Tribe, descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on the world thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before.<ref name="Conviction" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the Human had reached the rank of [[Sith Saber]] and was part of a [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]] sent to the planet [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]] to capture the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Conviction" />

During that mission, he served under fellow Sith Saber [[Tola Annax]]. Together with [[Gavar Khai's petty officer|two]] [[Unidentified Sith Saber (Luke Skywalker victim)|other]] Sith Sabers and Annax, the Human [[First duel in Kesla Vein|ambushed]] at a [[Kesla Vein pumping station|pumping station]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Kesla Vein]] the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]; his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]]; and fugitive [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], who were also searching for Abeloth. The Human proceeded to [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]] Ben Skywalker during the ensuing fight but was [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] by his Jedi opponent after a short time.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Personality and traits==
The Human was in good physical condition by 44 ABY. During the mission to Nam Chorios, he wore clothes typical for a settler on the planet.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Sith Saber possessed the [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] required to achieve the rank of Sith Saber in the tribe.<ref name="Conviction" />

==Equipment==
The Sith Saber owned a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] containing a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="Conviction" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sith Saber appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction|''Conviction'']], the seventh novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series that was published in [[2011]].<ref name="Conviction" />
